# Torque Studio – Marketing design subscription for startups and growing teams

> All your marketing design. One subscription. Design subscription for startups and growing teams. On your team, not on your payroll: landing pages, decks, ads and social, designed by a senior team with agency and in-house experience. Every request delivered within 3 working days.

Based in Barcelona, Spain · working with clients in the EU, UK & US. Design subscription in Spain: https://torquestudio.es/design-subscription-spain (Español: https://torquestudio.es/es/suscripcion-diseno-espana).

Torque Studio is a design studio on subscription, run by Pavlo Lobodiuk (Founder · Senior Designer) and Anastasiia Odiehova (Head of Operations), for product companies and consumer brands: a senior designer who owns the thinking, a head of operations who runs the queue and the deadlines, and an AI production engine that does the volume inside rules set by hand. Every piece is reviewed before it ships. Requests come back within 3 working days. Three plans, by how many requests are in progress at the same time: Ignition (one, €2,000 a month, or €1,800 a month billed quarterly), Cruise (two, €3,500 a month, or €3,150 a month billed quarterly), Full Throttle (three, €4,500 a month, or €4,050 a month billed quarterly); quarterly billing saves 10%. The fee stays flat until the plan changes. Full company websites are a separate project, from €3,000 depending on pages, functionality and content.

## Services ("Everything your marketing runs on")

- **Campaign landing pages**: Single pages for ads, launches and events. Designed, built, launched and hosted, no developer needed.
- **Ad creatives**: Several versions to test, not one pretty version.
- **Pitch decks**: Complex product stories made simple for investors and buyers.
- **Social media**: Posts, carousels, covers. Consistent every week.
- **AI visuals & video**: Product shots, campaign imagery, animated banners and short AI video.

## Work

Concept projects – self-initiated work that shows how we think and build.
- [Betting & iGaming](https://torquestudio.es/lamplight/): Fewer slots, each one finished.
- [Running Shoes](https://torquestudio.es/umbra.html): Show the engineering, skip the hype.
- [Architecture Firm](https://torquestudio.es/obra-gris.html): Feel the buildings before you meet the architect.
- [Urban Sunglasses](https://torquestudio.es/obskura.html): Six frames. 640 pairs. Then gone.
- [IT Company](https://torquestudio.es/sonde/): Monitoring that lets the team sleep.
- [Beverage](https://torquestudio.es/undergrove.html): A soda that explains itself.
